fees.note: From the operator's pricing page (read 2026-10-13): overnight sites are $65 on weeknights and $75 on weekends, which take a 2-night minimum, except the water-view back-ins (under 28 ft), which are $55 and $65.  Holiday and event weekends are $85 with a 3-night minimum.  Campspot, where the sites are booked, quotes the same weeknight rates on October 20 and November 10, which it shows closed, and $65-75 on Saturday, October 17.  Plus the park's $4 'Booking Fee', once per stay.  Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3).

source: https://firelakecampground.com/campsite-prices-rules/ (read 2026-10-13); https://www.campspot.com/book/firelakecampground (Campspot's pricing for each RV site type, one night from 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2026-11-10, 2026-11-14, 2 adults; two nights from each Tuesday for the park's fees; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13

The Town of Clover's campground page (read 2026-10-13) gives the same $50 a night for RV sites, plus tax and fees; the electric-only sites, which Campspot lists as under 23 ft, are $40.
